extracted.name: 2-ingredient pizza dough
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by Good Food member Beepbopbecca and has not been tested by our team.

yield.unit: medium pizza bases or 1 large pizza base

instruction_lines: Mix yoghurt and flour in a bowl until the mixture no longer sticks to your hands, adding more flour as needed, until the mixture is a dough.
On a floured counter, roll dough into shape/size desired. Brush with oil on both sides.
Cook in a pre-heated oven for 10-20 mins. For pizza it's recommended to put in oven about 10 mins before putting topping on.
